description: JVM stdlib boundary slice (ISSUE-0097). JVM-only fixtures that run the real DEAL frontend (lexer → parser → name resolver → type checker) → real JvmBackend codegen → javac subprocess → java subprocess executing the emitted artifact (the harness fails a fixture whose codegen or JVM execution is bypassed). Covered forms: the stdlib modules whose declared functions use only the slice's prerequisite value types — std/console (observable stdout/stderr output), std/string (UTF-8 byte-wise length incl. the "héllo" 6-byte pin, substring with the LuaJIT clipping and negative-start corrections, plain-text contains/startsWith/endsWith incl. the empty-part and pattern-magic-character pins, plain-text replace incl. the empty-old and %-in-replacement pins, split incl. the empty-string/empty-separator/consecutive/leading/trailing separator pins, trim with the Lua %s whitespace set), std/math (floor/ceil/sqrt/absInt/absNumber/minInt/maxInt incl. negative inputs and the extreme negative absInt, sqrt of a negative number → E8001 runtime error), std/time (nowMillis positive, recent, and second-truncated like LuaJIT's os.time() * 1000), stdlib results composing across modules, a frontend compile-error gate (E5001 wrong argument type) rejected before any backend runs, and a multi-module fixture where an imported compiled project module consumes std/string through the real orchestrator pipeline. std/table and std/json stay out of this slice (their only functions require table values) — their E6000 import rejection is pinned by JvmBackendTest.testStdlibTableBoundaryRejected.

tests.name: jvm-std-console-output
tests.description: std/console.log and std/console.error are observable on stdout and stderr (captured by the runner's merged stream)

tests.name: jvm-std-string-length
tests.description: std/string.length counts UTF-8 bytes like LuaJIT's #s: "hello" → 5, "" → 0, "héllo" → 6 (the multibyte pin — 500 only when the byte semantics hold)

tests.name: jvm-std-string-substring
tests.description: std/string.substring applies the LuaJIT string.sub corrections over the DEAL 0-based exclusive bounds: the whole string, the middle, start === end, start > end, end clipped to the string length, start past the end, and a negative start corrected from the end

tests.name: jvm-std-string-search
tests.description: std/string.contains/startsWith/endsWith match plain text (Lua pattern magic characters are literal), the empty part is contained/prefix/suffix of every string, and negative cases compute — the ten predicate pins accumulate to 1023

tests.name: jvm-std-string-replace
tests.description: std/string.replace replaces every plain-text occurrence, returns the original on no match, returns the original when old is empty, treats Lua pattern magic characters literally, and treats % in the replacement literally

tests.name: jvm-std-string-split
tests.description: std/string.split reproduces LuaJIT's plain-text split: separator split, single-element array, the empty string yielding the empty array whatever the separator, the empty separator splitting into individual characters, and consecutive/leading/trailing separators producing empty parts
tests.expectedOutput:
a
b
c
hello
a
b
c
a

b

a

e

tests.name: jvm-std-string-trim
tests.description: std/string.trim removes leading and trailing Lua %s whitespace (space, tab, newline — the vertical-tab/form-feed members of the %s set are pinned by JvmBackendTest.testStdlibExecution because the harness JSON dialect has no \uXXXX escapes and DEAL has no escape for them), keeps internal whitespace, and maps an all-whitespace string to the empty string

tests.name: jvm-std-math-int
tests.description: std/math.absInt/minInt/maxInt compute on negative and positive operands, including absInt of the extreme negative safe int -9007199254740991 (every intermediate sum stays inside the safe range: small = 23, diff = g - 9007199254740968 = 23, total 46)

tests.name: jvm-std-math-number
tests.description: std/math.floor/ceil/sqrt/absNumber compute on positive and negative inputs (floor(-3.2) === -4.0, ceil(-3.2) === -3.0, sqrt(9.0) === 3.0)

tests.name: jvm-std-math-sqrt-negative
tests.description: std/math.sqrt of a negative number raises E8001 'sqrt of negative number' exactly like std/math.lua — a real runtime error surfaced by executing the emitted artifact (exit 1)
tests.source:
import * as math from "std/math"
export function test(): number { return math.sqrt(-1.0); }

tests.name: jvm-std-time-nowmillis
tests.description: std/time.nowMillis() returns a positive, recent, second-truncated epoch milliseconds value (LuaJIT's os.time() * 1000 granularity — the % 1000 === 0 pin)

tests.name: jvm-std-compose
tests.description: stdlib results compose across modules: str.length feeds math.absInt, str.trim feeds str.contains, and the observable console output pins both paths

tests.name: jvm-std-frontend-error
tests.description: A wrong stdlib argument type (str.length(42) where length wants a string) is rejected by the frontend type checker (E5001) before any backend runs — codegen/javac/java never invoked
tests.source:
import * as str from "std/string"
export function test(): int { return str.length(42); }

tests.name: jvm-std-module-import
tests.description: A compiled project module consumes std/string through the real orchestrator pipeline (stdlib declaration resolution, module discovery, JVM codegen of both modules), and the imported wordCount splits 'a b c' into 3 words across the module boundary

modules.main.deal:
import * as lib from "./lib"
export function run(): int { return lib.wordCount("a b c"); }
